text:
nisha: quick ping. small API ergonomics question: should Generator.Token() return (string, error) since auth callbacks can fail? currently it returns string and we only set headers at send time which hides errors.

andrew: good catch. returning (string, error) would force callers to handle token fetch failures but most users don't call Token() directly. It's the transport that needs to handle it.

sam: if token provider returns error mid-stream, we should convert to ErrStreamAuthExpired and fail the stream. Transport already swallows nil tokens and keeps going which is bad.

ci-bot: go-sdk CI flaky: TestTokenProviderMidStreamError (job 8632)

nisha: opening tiny PR to make token supplier return (string, error) internally and bubble errors up to transport which turns them into ErrStreamAuthFetch. Will follow up with sampleapp docs.

andrew: keep the public API surface stable; do this internal-only for v1.1 patch. Good call.

sam: also add unit that simulates token provider error mid-stream and assert exported error.

nisha: will do. thanks!
